static_traits.name: Guo Licheng
static_traits.social_status: has several close friends, but has not yet discussed Self-doubt with them; social and support systems affected after separation
static_traits.medical_history: no significant past physical or mental illness history; no past psychological counseling or treatment history

basic_info.main_problem: despite winning my first big case as a Lawyer, I still struggle with Self-doubt and feeling not good enough, and always negate the positive aspects of my achievements.
basic_info.core_demands: I really want to change my mindset and stop belittling my achievements. This has affected my work and personal life too much.
growth_experiences: Self-doubt and not-good-enough feelings began and worsened about 6 months ago after the wife left; separation and Work stress seen as triggers; social and support systems affected (though having several close friends,Self-doubt not yet discussed); daily life impaired (running Decreased interest, becoming like a chore).

core_beliefs: I do not deserve my current success

special_situations.event: After winning the first big case of one's career
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if success is not perfect or fully attributable to my ability, then it does not count as real success, showing I am still not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: seeking colleagues' approval, magnifying flaws to whip oneself, thus avoiding the threat of 'not being good enough'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Anyone could win this case / it was just luck

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if others praise me, they are mostly just being polite rather than sincere; accepting praise would expose my inadequacy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Belittles and avoids internalizing positive feedback, verbally downplays praise to protect the self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: they are just being polite, I actually have not done well

special_situations.event: reviewing Work in professional settings, especially after major achievements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: as long as there is any mistake or flaw, the whole is a failure and I am not qualified
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on problems and mistakes, repeatedly self-criticizing to force oneself to work harder
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: with these mistakes, I do not deserve praise

special_situations.event: Self-evaluation that appeared in work settings after marital separation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if my partner left me, it meansI am not worthy of being loved, and I am not good enough in other areas either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively pursues external recognition at work, using achievements to prove self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: she left becauseI am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and loved (to be genuinely affirmed in intimate relationships and career)
core_conflict.fear: fear of being negated and abandoned, worrying that oneself is not worthy of being loved
defense_goal: avoiding the Fear of being exposed as 'not good enough' by belittling achievements and external attribution
seeking external validation to ease the anxiety of Being rejected and not being loved

object_relations.self_representation: a not-good-enough self that could be exposed at any time

object_relations.object_representation: A significant other (partner) who will leave and reject him

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving positive feedback/praise in counseling or at work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believing the other is merely polite or perfunctory, with a true attitude of questioning and negating (transference: Projecting self-nonacceptance onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: negating praise in a light or self-deprecating tone, emphasizing 'it is just luck/they are too polite', avoiding emotional contact.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing own achievements or asked to summarize success factors
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: attributing success to external chance or others' help, to maintain the inner schema of 'I am not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes external conditions, luck, or favorable procedures, avoids talking about own ability and effort; tone is rational and restrained.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to attend to own feelings or positives (e.g., counselor focuses on achievement experience)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Separates emotion from events, turning to abstract analysis to avoid feelings of vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses analytical language in place of emotional description, maintains an objective tone, avoids self-appreciation or vulnerable expression.

attributing inner non-acceptance to others' insincerity

manifestations: When describing work performance, repeatedly blames himself and magnifies mistakes
staying cautious in self-expression, worrying about appearing 'not good enough'

cognitive biases of negating the positive and mental filtering

target_behavior.behavior: persistent Self-deprecation and negating positive feedback after achievements, repeatedly seeking others' approval
antecedent: Achieving notable accomplishments in professional settings (such as winning a big case)
Receiving praise from colleagues or others
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth damaged after marital separation, forming the negative core belief 'I am not good enough/do not deserve success', maintained through negating the positive and mental filtering
target_behavior.function: avoiding the Fear of being negated or 'exposed', while temporarily easing unease through external approval
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance and Damaged confidence, decreased enjoyment of interest activities (e.g. running),Daily functioning affected
